_doc: Oil path definitions for forecast.py. Brent spot FOB, $/bbl, NSA. Each path = actual EIA daily Brent (quarterly mean of trading days) for completed quarters; the quarter containing the last observation is spliced day-weighted (observed days + remaining weekdays at the rule value, Thanksgiving/Dec 25/Jan 1 dropped); later quarters = rule or STEO quarterly mean. Rules start the day after the last EIA observation. Definitions from Agent B (02_Research/Subtasks/12_slide3b_research/outputs/B_q3_path_definitions.md), coordinator-verified 2026-11-15. central=true marks the 3 paths on the 3x2 grid; the rest are sensitivity rows.

variants.label: P1 Baseline oil: latest EIA STEO Brent path
variants.source: EIA STEO archive <latest>_base.xlsx, sheet 2tab, BREPUUS; quarter = mean of monthly

variants.label: P1 alt (market check): NYMEX BZ futures closes 2026-11-13
variants.source: Yahoo Finance chart API closes of NYMEX BZ contracts [secondary]; quarter = mean of 3 contract months; rest of current quarter at the front (BZ=F) close

variants.label: P2 Oil rises again: Brent $110 flat
